newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S KOHLER SELLS INTRATEX UNIT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S KOHLER SELLS INTRATEX UNIT.

text.p: South African packaging group Kohler Ltd said on Thursday that it had taken another step towards focusing its activities on core businesses by selling printing and publishing firm Intratex.
No financial details of the deal were disclosed.
Kohler is seeking to concentrate on its packaging and tissue-making operations.
"The sale of Intratex at net asset value will not have any impact on the group's earnings, but the disposal further refines Kohler's focus," chief executive Richard Bruyns said in a statement.
The packaging industry is currently under pressure in South Africa as high interest rates have knocked consumer confidence to low levels.

"However, while there is little buoyancy at present in these markets, it is not all doom and gloom. Our sales of packaging to the citrus industry have been good and our export markets continue to grow," Bruyns said.
